info.title: Levea AI Video Editor API
info.description: API to interact with Levea's autonomous AI video editor. Allows submitting natural-language editing briefs, generating viral clips, adding active word-by-word captions, applying motion graphics, and exporting final MP4 videos.

post.description: Takes a natural-language description (prompt) of the desired edit, planning, executing, and returning the result.

tool.description: The tool to run. Keep as 'autonomous_edit' for natural-language prompts.

prompt.description: Natural-language description of the desired edit or creative brief. The backend planner decomposes it into canonical actions (viral clips, captions, reframe, export, …). Send the user's intent verbatim — do not pre-decompose.

project_id.description: Optional project id for tracking and continuity. Reuse the projectId returned by the first call for every continuation.

video_url.description: Optional public source video URL (HTTP/HTTPS: S3, Google Drive public link, Dropbox, direct MP4) for a new project. Local file paths are not supported.

assets.description: Optional input media assets. URLs must be public HTTP/HTTPS links.

url.description: Publicly accessible HTTP/HTTPS URL to the video, image, or audio asset.

captionTemplatePreset.description: Optional caption template to apply when (re)generating captions: a builtin slug (e.g. hormozi, mrbeast, viral-pop, karaoke, neon-pop, subtitle-bar) or a user-saved template id. Call list_caption_templates for the exact ids available.

export_url.description: Direct URL to the finished MP4 video render.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the edits performed.

400.description: Bad Request. Missing prompt or invalid parameter format.

401.description: Unauthorized. Check your Levea API key.

402.description: Payment Required. Quota exceeded on current subscription plan.
